item.title: Luan 0.1.0 (Build 17)
item.description:
• Refreshed Settings icons in Luan's brand colors.
  • Each Settings page now has a title card, and list rows show icons.
  • Links on the About page are easier to tell apart.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. Test license activation is still simulated and does not represent a purchase.
